consensus.title: Cache key version change causes cache miss storm

responses.content: NO_ISSUES_FOUND: Correct, safe, well-structured, and no simpler version is worth the change.

* [WARNING] LOGIC <Cache key version change causes cache miss storm> (at profile_cache_key)
    - Issue: Changing the cache key format from "profile:{user_id}" to "profile:v2:{user_id}" will render all existing cached profiles invisible, causing a cache miss for every request until the cache is repopulated. Under high traffic this can lead to a sudden increase in load on the backing store (e.g., database or external service) and potential latency spikes or overload.
    - Fix: Either introduce a dual-read period where the service checks both the old and new key formats (writing to both) during a rolling deployment, or provide a migration script to rename existing keys in Redis before the change, or keep the old key format as a fallback for a limited timeNO_ISSUES_FOUND: Correct, safe, well-structured, and no simpler version is worth the change.
